title: The flat I didn't want
text: Last year, Daniyar decided to move to Almaty for a new job. He expected to find a flat quickly, but unfortunately it wasn't easy. The first flat that he saw was tiny, and the second one, which was near the centre, was too expensive — he simply couldn't afford it. A colleague who had lived in the city for years gave him some useful advice: “Look for something near a metro station, not in the centre. It's the best way to save money and time.” Daniyar followed her advice. Eventually he found a comfortable flat in a quiet area where many young families live. The rent was reasonable, and the station was only five minutes away. Now he has a simple routine: he leaves home at eight to avoid the traffic, and he uses the journey to learn new English words on his phone. “At first I was disappointed,” he says, “but now I realize that the flat I didn't want is the place that I like most. I really appreciate my colleague's help. Sometimes the best opportunities are the ones you don't expect.”
